title: 悟空·桃子小篮
description: 金棕猴王悟空穿完整红金甲衣，坐在石凳上给桃子篮盖布，长棍静立架边。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Wukong is an adult monkey-like vastaya with golden-brown fur, a lively simian face, a small golden headband, a long curling tail, and red-gold armor accents. Preserve his expressive ears and compact agile silhouette with a fully covering tunic, opaque trousers, arm guards, and boots. His long gold-tipped staff rests upright in a secure stand, never swung or used for acrobatics.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a rounded stone bench and tucks a checked cloth over a basket of peaches, glancing mischievously at one peach left outside. His tail forms a soft curve beside the bench. A small tree branch and pale hill suggest a peaceful courtyard, with both feet grounded and the staff still nearby.
art_direction.palette: golden brown, warm red, peach pink, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
